source_table.notes:
Voriconazole efficacy against 10 C. albicans isolates, disseminated candidiasis model
S02 | DOI 10.1128/AAC.47.10.3165-3169.2003 | Table 1
Neutropenic mice as in the PK block; 0.1 ml inoculum (10^4.8-10^5.9 CFU/ml) via the lateral tail vein 2 h before therapy. Isolate K-1: 24 regimens, six total doses (0.078, 0.3125, 1.25, 5, 20, 80 mg/kg/24 h) each split every 3, 6, 12 or 24 h; other isolates: six total doses 0.08-320 mg/kg/24 h split every 6 h "for the 24-h study period".
Groups of two mice per regimen; drug given in 0.2-ml volumes, route of PD dosing not stated (PK used oral gavage). Kidneys removed "at the end of therapy"; the K-1 section gives no explicit duration. Endpoint change in log10 CFU per pair of kidneys (detection limit 100 CFU/kidneys).
MICs by NCCLS M27-A at 48 h (geometric mean of 3); inhibition endpoint not stated. Fluconazole MIC column is a comparator drug. Per-regimen CFU values are in figures only (not transcribed). Header printed over two rows; "Voriconzole" spelled as printed. No footnotes.
